verdict.rationale: Cooley explicitly represents both sides of venture deals — 2,100+ VC financings annually split evenly between investor and company representation, plus primary counsel to 950+ funds — and publishes market-terms data (quarterly Venture Financing Report, #1 ranked for VC-backed company representation) that reflects both perspectives. Cooley GO's free document generators (SAFE, Series Seed) further embed current market-standard terms drawn from this dual-sided practice. Missing for 10: no independent/community source explicitly corroborates that the same team blends investor+company market intelligence into deal terms (beyond the firm's own claims).
